stances.summary: Suggests China used diplomatic workaround on Rubio ban
stances.quote:
Secretary of State Marco Rubio, a fierce China critic, was banned in 2020 from entering the country. 

Chinese officials, however, are using a different transliteration of Rubio’s name, perhaps to allow him to visit without lifting the ban.

stances.summary: Suggests China used name transliteration as diplomatic tool
stances.quote:
After Rubio was named Sec of State, Chinese gov't changed the Chinese character for Ru/Lu in Rubio's name. It may have been a clever diplomatic tool that lets China to allow him in the country, since sanctions on Rubio are under the previous spelling.
wapo.st/4fl3FFO

stances.summary: Reports name change may have enabled Rubio's China visit
stances.quote:
A name change in Chinese characters may have allowed Secretary of State Marco Rubio -- a fierce China critic who was banned in 2020 from entering the country -- to visit China as part of President Donald Trump’s entourage.
